feature: Animate a property opens over the panel, at once
summary: Animate a property's list now opens over the Properties section, where the mock puts it, instead of in a popover out over the canvas. It opens in about 35 ms (was 110) and closes in about 18 (was 70), and you can type to find a value the moment it opens.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. A recording with a typed title picked.

try.do: Type a title on a recording, press Cmd-Return, and pick it with the Select tool.
Click Animate a property in the Properties section.
Press Delete three times, type blu, then press Return.
Open the list again and press Escape.
Open it once more and click anywhere outside it.

evaluate: Does the list opening over the section, rather than out over the canvas, feel like the right place?
Is it obvious you can type straight away, with the caret drawn in the box?
Does opening and closing it now feel instant?
With the list open, does B or V typed into it ever change a tool? (It should not.)
rough: Picking a value still holds about 60 ms the first time in a session and 45 to 51 after, over the 50 ms line, because the change redraws most of the window. Carried, with the measurements, by keying-a-value-redraws-only-what-the-key-changes.
The mock draws a colour value with a swatch of its colour; the list still draws the same diamond on every row. Filed as a-colour-in-animate-a-property-shows-its-swatch.
The find box reads keys itself rather than holding the keyboard, so it has a caret but no selection: you cannot drag-select or arrow through what you typed. Paste (Cmd-V) and Delete work.
The list sits at the top of the section, under its header, so it covers the rows above Animate a property while it is open, as the mock's does.
